plain: Ordinary church members, as opposed to the clergy

webster.text: The people, as distinguished from the clergy; the body of the people not in orders.

example.quote: More or less in all places, pride and indolence in the Clergy, ignorance and servility in the laity, in both, superstition, bigotry and persecution.
example.cite: James Madison, Memorial and Remonstrance Against Religious Assessments, c. June 20, 1785
